summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing the manual for an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) to be held on July 2, 2026. The agenda is routine: fix the number of board members, elect two new directors, and confirm the board composition. No price, premium, acquisition, divestiture, or special-situation terms are present. This is a standard EGM notice with no extraordinary event; the 6-K is a routine foreign private issuer filing equivalent to a US proxy notice. The filing contains no deal, no tender, no restructuring, no activist campaign, and no management change that itself constitutes the event.
